name: Schroder European Real Estate Investment Trust PLC
source: Audited consolidated statement of comprehensive income, Schroder European Real Estate Investment Trust plc annual report for the year ended 30 September 2025 (page 67) and annual report for the year ended 30 September 2023 (page 64), EUR thousands scaled to units. Revenue is rental and service charge income, cost of sales is property operating expenses, gross profit is net rental and related income. Profit before tax less income tax equals profit for the year in every column, and operating profit less net finance costs equals profit before tax in every column. EPS is the printed basic and diluted figure. The file previously carried a Yahoo Finance revenue series with a negative FY2023 value, which is arithmetically impossible for a revenue magnitude.

rows.label: Revenue
rows.note: Rental and service charge income, consolidated statement of comprehensive income

rows.label: Cost of Sales
rows.note: Property operating expenses, the direct cost of rental income

rows.label: Gross Profit
rows.note: Net rental and related income as printed

rows.label: Operating Expenses
rows.note: Total expenses as printed (investment management fee, valuers and professional fees, administrator and accounting fees, auditor remuneration, directors fees, other expenses)

rows.label: Operating Profit (EBIT)
rows.note: Operating profit or loss as printed. This is after the fair value movement on investment property and the development result, which sit between net rental income and total expenses in the printed statement, so gross profit less operating expenses does not equal this row

rows.label: Net Finance Costs
rows.note: Net finance costs as printed: finance costs less finance income

rows.label: Profit Before Tax
rows.note: Profit or loss before taxation as printed. Operating profit less net finance costs reproduces this row exactly

rows.label: Income Tax
rows.note: Taxation as printed; FY2023 is a credit

rows.label: Net Profit
rows.note: Profit or loss for the year as printed

rows.label: EPS
rows.note: Basic and diluted earnings per share attributable to owners of the parent, as printed in euro cents converted to euro

mergedSources: SEREIT audited annual report 2025 (year to 30 Sep 2025)
SEREIT audited annual report 2023 (year to 30 Sep 2023)
